## Plan useful batches and test checkpoints

Planning guidance now asks agents to choose batches large enough to deliver a meaningful outcome
and small enough to review and diagnose. The implementation-plan template makes the planner
responsible for the default test cadence, including focused development checks, expensive builds,
integration proof, and the independent review boundary. Writers may adjust checkpoints when new
evidence or risk warrants it.

Routine plan, status, evidence summaries, and explanatory documentation move to batch closeout.
Governing contracts stay current when dependent work needs them. Passing test evidence remains
reusable only while its relevant inputs are valid. Cost observations use existing records without
adding collectors or reporting gates.

This patch changes shared guidance and templates. Runtime execution, configuration compatibility,
required checks, and provider adapters retain their existing contracts. The Gemini live-validation
limitation documented in 2.4.0 remains unresolved; this release makes no new Gemini capability claim.

Existing repositories receive the guidance through a deliberate pinned-wheel upgrade. Adopter-owned
instructions and plans may need alignment with the new batch boundaries.
